items.title: Sharkey Bonano Interview, 1966-11-09
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Any other favorite clarinet players you can think of that you've played with that you... Well, I mentioned Sidney Ayrton. Yeah, Sidney Ayrton. I never got to hear him. >> [INTERVIEWEE] Charlie Cadella.

ctx.x: I wish I'd heard him. Yeah. Too late now. Any other favorite clarinet players you can think of that you've played with that you... Well, I mentioned Sidney Ayrton. Yeah, Sidney Ayrton. I never got to hear him.
